cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Spare Them the Hassle
cards.instruction: Hide a practical problem because you believe handling it alone is kinder than involving anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Sit down, love. You've been on the ward all night. I'll bring lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's there a bucket by my chair?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Just catching a drip. Take the sofa; I've made you a tray.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll eat upstairs and go straight to bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay here. I'll bring your duvet down; upstairs needs a little drying before I put your bed back.

mechanism: A uses qualified household-care instructions to conceal the size of a leak from an exhausted partner, moving rest arrangements instead of letting B help.
confusable: D13 hides A fault; D39 need not involve culpability, but A kindness motive and wish to shoulder the problem alone must be apparent.
comparison: Bike alternative hides fragmented repair logistics to preserve leisure; leak alternative relocates a tired worker rest without explaining the full damage.
seedUse: Night ward shift, bucket and unusable upstairs bed derive from D39-a; S03 adds orderly containment and rest instructions as protective concealment.
